content.title: Chapter 42 - FIRE PREVENTION AND PROTECTION — Sec. 42-32. - I.F.C. Section 101.1, Title.
content.summary:
Section 101.1. Title,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
101.1 Title.
These regulations shall be known as the Fire Code of the City of Arvada, hereinafter
                  referred to as "this code," or "IFC.""
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
